blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The investigation into the Philippine Air Force (PAF) aircraft crash that killed four pilots in Batangas will examine flight planning, pilot training, maintenance and command leadership, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said on Saturday. Teodoro said investigators would look into all aspects of the incident, stressing that established accident investigation procedures must not be bypassed. “Hintayin natin ‘yung accident investigation. Alam mo iyan ay isang in-instill din natin sa Philippine Air Force, tamang proseso ng accident investigation. Merong proseso ‘yan at hindi dapat shino-shortcut,” he told reporters on the sidelines of the Philippine Military Academy’s 128th founding anniversary […]...
